verdict.rationale: Capacities is object-type-first, with custom object types carrying structured properties, and its pricing page lists "Smart queries" as a feature. The export docs mention "collections", which implies some grouped views of objects. Beyond that bare pricing-line mention, nothing describes how queries work or what views they render. missing for 10: documentation of how smart queries filter or sort by property values, evidence of live table/board/list view rendering, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
